inspect-report.humanDescription: Inspect existing material and report findings without changing the requested result.

research-decide.humanDescription: Collect current facts or compare alternatives and return a supported decision.

mechanical-change.humanDescription: Apply a clear decision-free transformation with known checks.

debug-fix.humanDescription: Reproduce a failure, correct it, and prove the failing behavior now passes.

implement-build.humanDescription: Build a specified behavior and prove it works.

refactor.humanDescription: Reshape existing work while preserving its recorded behavior.

review-polish.humanDescription: Review or improve an existing result within the requested boundaries.

external-operation.humanDescription: Perform an authorized action outside the local deliverable and verify its effects.

incompatibleCombinations.reason: A read-only inspection cannot itself perform a destructive migration.
A read-only inspection cannot itself perform an irreversible action.
Research can study a migration but cannot execute it under this base work type.

terminationPolicy.retryProgressRule: Every failed attempt consumes one maxAttempts unit; a retry also requires a changed declared fingerprint after maxUnchangedFailures.

findingClosure.blocking: repair or evidence-backed non-defect closure is required
findingClosure.advisory: recorded residual risk may remain when the user request still passes
